trailhead.label: The square in Carcoforo (1,304 m), the park authority’s start

cautions: Grazing pastures at the Alpe Giovanchera, Pianelli and Passone in summer: lead on, and give flocks and guard dogs a wide berth.
Old stone paving and steps near Carcoforo, slippery when wet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
